session_summary: Fixed the relay popen3 hang (the #1 bug from last session). Refactored relay to two-phase boot: entrypoint.sh as root for WG/creds, gosu to agent for relay. Added tini for zombie reaping. Backgrounded boot so HTTP server starts immediately. Built service exposure layer: socat forwarders for localhost-bound services, iptables restrictions for wildcard-bound services. All services reachable from inside agent containers over WireGuard. SSH locked down to wg-ssh + LAN only. Seeds completed with real WG public keys and endpoints.

hub.what: Rails app. Matrix appservice. Routing table.
key_files: app/services/hub/router.rb — the heart, routes Matrix messages to agents

manager.what: Rails app. Container lifecycle. Auth provisioning. Admin UI.
manager.db: SQLite — containers, agent_configs, room_configs, agent_room_configs, service_types, audit_logs
key_files: app/services/spawner.rb — the spawn flow, IP allocation, spawn.json generation
app/services/lifecycle.rb — freeze, sunset, force kill, teardown
app/services/provisioner.rb — Forgejo users, SSH keys, API tokens
app/services/wireguard.rb — calls wg-admin helper for peer management
app/services/podman.rb — container creation via podman socket
config/initializers/surface.rb — declares everything the Manager touches
manager.admin_ui: Tailwind, dark stone/amber palette. Dashboard, agent configs with service checkboxes, room configs, container monitoring with stream viewer, audit log.

relay.what: Lives inside every agent container. WireGuard + Claude Code glue.
relay.auth: Copies ~/.claude/.credentials.json from mounted secret. OAuth token, not API key.
relay.containerfile: relay/Containerfile — ruby:3.3-slim + node/npm + wireguard-tools + gosu + tini + Claude Code
relay.entrypoint: relay/entrypoint.sh — Phase 1 (root): WG, credentials, SSH keys. Phase 2: exec gosu agent ruby relay.rb

wg_admin.what: Tiny HTTP helper on the host. Accepts add-peer/remove-peer from Manager.

service_ports.valley: 4006 (Evennia, NOT 4002 — actual port differs from spec)

network.routing: Source-based policy routing. Each service IP gets a routing table.

service_exposure.mechanism: Two approaches based on current bind address
service_exposure.localhost_services: socat forwarders: WG_IP:port → 127.0.0.1:port (Vikunja, ComfyUI, Evennia, Ollama)
service_exposure.wildcard_services: iptables DROP on non-designated WG interfaces (Forgejo, Matrix, SSH)
service_exposure.ssh_lockdown: Port 2222 DROP'd on all WG interfaces except wg-ssh. LAN (172.16.1.101) always allowed.
service_exposure.status: Tested and working. socat forwarders NOT persistent yet — need systemd unit.

network.init_script: infra/init.sh — builds entire WG network + service exposure from infra/services.conf. Idempotent. Run with sudo.
network.keys: infra/wireguard/keys/ — all WG keypairs. Private keys are 0600.

relay_popen3_hang.root_cause: Open3.popen3 with uid: 1000 + unsetenv_others: true. The uid switching was flaky, and stripping env removed things Claude Code needed.
relay_popen3_hang.fix: Two-phase boot like old NeoClaw: entrypoint.sh runs as root for WG/creds, then exec gosu agent for relay. Relay runs as agent natively — no uid switching in popen3, inherits normal env.
also_fixed: Boot blocked HTTP server — now runs in background thread
Zombie processes from Claude Code tool calls — tini as PID 1
Output forwarding spam when Manager down — silent: true flag
Removed httpx gem dependency — relay uses stdlib Net::HTTP
Manager Podman.run: added spawn path translation (container→host) and credentials mount

socat_persistence.symptom: socat forwarders for localhost-bound services (Vikunja, ComfyUI, Evennia, Ollama) are started by init.sh but don't survive reboot.
socat_persistence.fix: Write a systemd unit or add to init.sh's systemd integration. PIDs stored in /run/neoclaw-forwarders.pids.

what_doesnt_work_yet.manager_spawn_flow: The Manager's Spawner.resolve is written but never called via the API. The Hub→Manager→Container chain is untested end-to-end.
what_doesnt_work_yet.provisioner_untested: Provisioner.provision (Forgejo user creation, SSH key injection, token generation) exists but has never been called. The Forgejo admin API works (tested manually) but the Ruby code path is untested.
what_doesnt_work_yet.wg_admin_not_running: wg-admin/wg-admin.rb needs to be running on the host for the Manager to add/remove WG peers. Not started as a service yet.
what_doesnt_work_yet.init_sh_not_systemd: infra/init.sh creates WG interfaces but doesn't persist across reboot. Needs systemd units or /etc/wireguard/ configs.

things_that_bit_us: WireGuard multi-interface routing: kernel can only have one route per destination. Solved with source-based policy routing.
Bridge back door: podman containers have default route through bridge, can reach host-local WG IPs. Fixed with iptables INPUT rule.
UFW blocks WG handshake UDP from pods. Fixed with ufw allow on podman bridge.
Claude Code refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions as root. Agent container needs a non-root user.
Claude Code uses OAuth credentials in ~/.claude/.credentials.json, not ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var.
Open3.popen3 with uid: 1000 + unsetenv_others: true hangs on long Claude Code invocations. Fixed by using gosu in entrypoint instead.
Propshaft asset resolution: Tailwind builds need app/assets/builds/ registered as an asset path.
Ruby rescue inside while needs begin/end block.
Rails allow_browser on API controllers will 406 infrastructure requests.
DNAT to 127.0.0.1 doesn't work for Docker-containerized services (Docker has its own NAT chain that interferes).
DNAT to 127.0.0.1 requires net.ipv4.conf.<iface>.route_localnet=1 on EACH WG interface, not just 'all'.
Services on 0.0.0.0 are reachable on ALL WG interfaces — need per-interface iptables DROP rules to restrict.
Socat forwarders are the clean solution for localhost-bound services. No service config changes, no NAT complexity.
Forgejo SSH on *:2222 means any WG-peered agent can reach it regardless of authorization. Must restrict to wg-ssh.
